newsitem.title: USA: Scientific-Atlanta Q3 gross margins rise.
newsitem.headline: Scientific-Atlanta Q3 gross margins rise.

text.p: Scientific-Atlanta Inc on Thursday said its third quarter gross margins rose to 31.2 percent from last year's 27.7 percent on manufacturing cost reductions and favorable yen currency exchange rate.

Earlier, the company said net income for the third quarter ended March 28, 1997 was $16.5 million, or $0.21 per share, an increase of 43 percent compared to $11.5 million, or $0.15 per share, in the previous year's third quarter.
Sales were $301.7 million for the quarter, up 11 percent, compared to $271.9 million the prior year.
Domestic sales of terrestrial network products increased 16 percent, while international sales increased 32 percent over last year's third quarter, the company said.
Domestic sales of satellite communication products declined 4 percent and international sales declined 17 percent, the firm said.
The decline in international sales was primarily due to temporary order delays and delays in receiving letters of credit.
Scientific-Atlanta said it research and development spending amounted to $29.6 million in the current third quarter, up 23 percent from last year.
